**STEP 1 - Scene:** An airline-style breakfast tray: toast, a muffin, a milky coffee, two fried eggs, grilled tomato halves, mushrooms and butter packets. Photographed from the front at roughly eye level, with a colour checker card in the foreground.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The right-hand plate is a paper side plate, about 20 cm across. Area = 3.14 x 10² ≈ 314 cm². The left plate (toast) is similar in size and holds the bread and muffin.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Two fried eggs, two grilled tomato halves, three mushrooms, two slices of toast, one muffin, two butter packets, and a mug of milky coffee.

**STEP 4 - Area:** On the right plate, eggs cover about 20% (≈63 cm²), tomatoes about 10% (≈31 cm²), and mushrooms about 3% (≈9 cm²). Toast covers about 30% of the left plate. The muffin and butter are small.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Fried egg ≈ 196 kcal/100 g, so 196 kcal. Grilled tomato ≈ 25 kcal/100 g, so 25 kcal. Mushrooms ≈ 25 kcal/100 g, so 8 kcal. White toast ≈ 265 kcal/100 g, so 212 kcal. Muffin ≈ 380 kcal/100 g, so 152 kcal. Butter ≈ 717 kcal/100 g, so 72 kcal. Milky coffee ≈ 30 kcal/100 g, so 60 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 560 g of food and drink, and about 725 kcal. That fits a full cooked breakfast with coffee.
